name: cyberscore
description: Check any business domain's security from your AI assistant: email spoofing protection (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), website security, certificates and publicly reported exposed services, graded A to F with plain-English fixes. Free, no sign-up.

interface.longDescription: Ask your assistant how secure any business domain is and get CyberScore's outside-in check: whether the domain can be spoofed in email (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), how the website is protected (HTTPS, certificates, security headers, outdated encryption, exposed files), and what internet-wide scanners publicly report about its servers. Every result has a grade from A to F, the problems that matter most first, plain-English explanations and step-by-step fixes, plus a link to the full report. It also lists the vulnerabilities CISA confirms are being exploited right now. Uses public information only and needs no account.
capabilities: Grade a domain’s security from A to F
Check email spoofing protection (SPF, DMARC, DKIM)
defaultPrompt: Can someone send email pretending to be my domain?
What vulnerabilities are being exploited this week?
